tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i ngo sprod nang ma bzhugs/

na maḥshrī kā la tsakrā ya/ rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i ngo sprod nang mar grags pa thun mong ma yin pa rnams phyogs mtshon tsam zhig bshad par bya ste/ de yang du ba la sogs pa'i mthong snang dang*/ gzhan yang nyams kyi khyad par sna tshogs pa dag la 'char ba myur bul dang*/ phra rags dang*/ gsal mi gsal dang*/ brtan mi brtan gyi khyad par sna tshogs dag 'byung zhing*/ lus nyams sna tshogs pa'i snying po bde ba'i nyams yin la/ de la yang lus kyi phyogs re dang*/ lus phal cher dang*/ lus thams cad dang*/ lus sems gnyis ka dang*/ phyi nang thams cad bde bar 'char ba la sogs pa'i rim pa sna tshogs yod do/ /ngag nyams thams cad kyi snying po rlung 'gags pa yin la/ de la yang rlung 'gag tshul du ma yod cing*/ sems nyams kyi snying po rnam par mi rtog pa stong pa'i nyams yin la/ de lta bu'i stong nyams la'ang snang ba la sems mi 'phro ba tsam gyi mi rtog pa dang*/ mi rtog bzhin du rig pa'i dwangs gsal can dang*/ de nyid la yod med yin min gang gi mtshan mas ma reg par rjen cher du shes pa'i rim pa la'ang sna tshogs pa yod cing*/ de yang sems rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal gdod ma nas gsal ba'ang yin/ stong pa'ang yin/ bde ba'ang yin pa las/ rang bzhin gsal ba ste rnal 'byor pa'i blo ngor rtags su shar ba 'od gsal rtag bcu yin/ rang bzhin bde ba rnal 'byor pa'i blo ngor rtags su shar ba sor sdud kyi bde nyams nas brtsams te/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bde ba'i bar du yin/ rang bzhin stong pa rnal 'byor pa'i blo ngor rtags su shar ba dben gsum nas brtsams te mthar phyin pa'i bar du stong nyams shar ba rnams yin/ gsal stong bde ba gsum po gnas lugs la dbye ba med kyang rnal 'byor pa'i blo'i snang ngo la gsal cha/ stong cha bde cha re re nas 'char ba dang*/ gnyis ldan dang gsum ldan du 'char ba sogs sna tshogs pa zhig 'byung ngo*/ /de dag kyang gsal stong bde bar myong ba'i cha nas ma 'khrul ba yin la/

gcig dang tha dad la sogs pa mtshan ma gzhan du snang ba'i cha nas 'khrul pa yin kyang*/ 'khrul pas 'khrul pa sel ba'i tshul gyis yang dag pa'i gnas lugs rtogs pa'i thabs su 'gyur ba yin la/ 'khrul pa'i cha shas gtan nas zad pa ni sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kho na yin gyi/ lam gyi gnas skabs thams cad na 'dres mar spyod pa yin no/ /re zhig de tsam ni mdor bstan pa yin te/ thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal gdams las brtsams pa'i ngo sprod skor dang po'o/ /da ni don de dag cung zad zhib tu brjod na/ byed bcings zab mo la brten nas/ rten lus kyi phyos bzung na rlung sems dbu mar ci rigs par gnas par gyur/ brten pa sems kyi phyogs bzung ba ltar na/ sems nyid de sems nyid rang gi rang bzhin gsal stong bde ba la cung zad gnas pas/ rang gi rang bzhin ci rigs pa gsal bar shar/ dper na chu rgyun rnyog ma drag tu 'bab pa gcig las/ snod bzang po gcig tu blangs nas yung tsam zhig g.yo med du bzhag na rnyog pa de cung zad sangs su nye ba'i chu rang gi kha dog ci rigs pa steng du mngon pa bzhin no/ /des na rtsa rlung thig le sems rnams kyi dwangs ma'i rang gzugs de stong gzugs su shar ba yin te/ rtsa rlung thig le sems kyi chos sa khams kyis bsdus pa rnams kyi rang bzhin dwangs ma chos nyid de rnal 'byor pa'i blo ngor du ba dang 'bar ba'i rtags su shar/ de bzhin du chu khams kyi dwangs ma smig rgyu dang zla ba/ me khams kyi dwangs ma mkha' snang dang nyi ma/ rlung khams kyi dwangs mar me dang sgra gcan/ nam mkha' dang ye shes sam/ stong pa dang bde ba'i dwangs ma glog dang thig ler shar ba yin no/ /'dir dwangs ma zhes bya ba ni/ chos de rnams nyid kyi rang gzugs sam/ rang bzhin nam/ chos nyid de/ de yang gsal stong bde ba ro mnyam pa'i ye shes yin yang skabs 'dir rnal 'byor pa la gsal snang du shar bas de'i ldog cha nas smos na/

rang bzhin chos nyid gsal ba'i ye shes zhes brjod do/ gzhan yang 'di skad ces bya ste sgrub pa po la du ba dang*/ sgra gcan gyi ltas shar ba de ni sems rang bzhin 'od gsal bde gshegs snying po de dngos gnas la sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor bzhugs pa las/ kun rdzaub snang ba dang bstun te ldog chas phye na/ so so'i tha snyad sbyor te/ skabs 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa don yod grub pa la sogs pa rlung khams rnam par dag pa'i lha tshogs rnam mjal ba yin dag pa gnyis ldan gyi lha de rnams kyis byin gyis rlabs pa yin/ gzhi la bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas de rnams sngar sgrib g.yogs 'thug pos bsgribs te ma mthong ba las da ni sgrib g.yogs cung zad cig bsrab pas/ sangs rgyas de rnams kyi ye shes kyi cha shas cung zad cig mthong ba yin no/ /de yang bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsung las/ du ba lta bu gcig la yang nang tshan du khams drug gi dbye bas/ du ba ser po sa khams dkar po chu khams/ dmar po me khams/ nag po rlung khams/ ljang sngon nam mkha' ye shes te/ rlung khams nyid las phye ba'i 'byung chung lnga'i rang gzugs te/ du ba sogs rtags bcu'i rim pa rnams rnal 'byor pa thams cad la 'byung zhing*/ phal cher la go rim kyang ma 'khrugs par 'byung bas/ du ba thog mar mthong yang sgrub pa po las kyi rigs su ma nges la de'i nang tshan la gnas skabs rigs so sor nges pas/ du ba ser por mthong na sgrub pa po rnam snang gi rigs yin pas/ tshe 'di la ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag mthar phyin pa'am/ tshe 'phos nas sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad kyi dag pa'i zhing khams su 'gro ba yin la/ de bzhin du 'od dkar po 'od dpag med/ dmar po rin chen 'byung ldan/ nag po don yod grub pa/ ljang gu mi bskyod pa/ sngaun po rdo rje sems dpa' rnams la'ang rim bzhin sbyar/ rigs so sor nges pa'i go don i thi ba ni sems nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang bzh-in yin pas/

lam sgom pa'i tshe sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs 'jug mnyam yin kyang*/ thog mar dri ma 'dag tshul la gzugs phung gi dri ma byang ba'i 'go rtsom pa snga na rnam snang*/ 'du shes kyi dri ma dag pa 'go rtsom pa snga na 'od dpag med kyi rigs sogs te/ gzhan la'ang rigs 'gre'o/ /yang du ba sogs lha yab dang/ 'bar ba sogs lha yum la'ang sbyar zhing*/ nus ma bcu la'ang sbyor/ 'di dag don dam par dbye ba med kyang kun rdzob tu so sor sbyor ba 'di grangs mtshungs sam/ chos mtshungs tsam sbyor ba yin nam zhe na/ de ltar ma yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa yab yum bcu dang*/ nus ma bcu la sogs pa dngos yin pa la yin par ngo sprad pa yin no/ /de ltar mthong ba de dngos yin kyang lam phyi ma rnams bsgoms pas bogs med pa ma yin te/ dper na/ rab rib can gyis mthong ba'i ri de ri dngos yin kyang*/ phyis rab rib bsal nas bltas pa'i tshe snga ma dang khyad par shin tu che ba bzhin no/ de bzhin du du bar snang ba ni bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes kyi rang snang yin/ smig sgyu mnyam nyid/ mkha' snang sor rtog mar me chos dbyings/ thig le me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /'bar ba sogs lnga la'ang des rigs 'gre zhes so sor sbyar/ nang tshan du kha dog lnga'am drug ni tshad med lnga'i bdag nyid can te/ dung ser po ni/ bya sgrub ye shes byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang dbyer med pa'i ngo bo yin/ dkar po snying rje/ dmar bo dga' ba/ nag po btang snyoms/ ljang sngon ni thams cad mnyam pa nyid do zhes ngo sprod/ de bzhin rtags bcu po phar phyin bcu'i rang snang du yang ngo sprod de/ de dag ni rtags bcu so sor snang ba las brtsams nas/ re rer ngo sprod pa'i tshul te/ ngo sprod skor gnyis pa'o/ da ni de rnams thun mong du rnam pa thams cad pa'i chos nyid du ngo sprod pa la/ dang po du sogs kyi rtags rnams chos thams cad par bstan pa ni/

ji skad du/ chos kyi dbyings las ma gtog par/ /gang phyi chos med de y-i phyir/ / zhes gsung pa ltar/ du sogs 'od gsal gyi snang ba las gzhan pa'i chos med ces tha snyad sbyar te/ dper na me long dwangs pa la snod bcud kyi gzugs brnyan mtha' yas par shar na shar ba'i dus de nyid du me long las gzhan pa'i snod bcud kyi gzugs brnyan med ces bya ste/ des na sa khams kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad kyi chos nyid du ba'i rtags su shar/ du snang nyid chos nyid yin/ du snang chos nyid de nyid sems kyi rang bzhin du gdod ma nas gnas/ de ltar gnas kyang sngar ni chos nyid de la kun rdzaub 'khrul pa'i las snang sa khams kyi snang ba rnams shar nas/ dngos gnas la yod pa'i chos nyid du ba'i rnam pa can ma mthong*/ dngos gnas la med kyang 'khrul snang la shar pa'i sa khams las snang gis bsdus pa rnams mthong*/ skabs 'dir chos dbyings zab mo'i don la mnyam par bzhag pas sa khams ngos skal gyi dri ma cung zad bsrabs/ chos nyid kyi snang ba cung zad shar/ de yang chos dbyings de du ba'i snang ba ma yin pa la du ba'i rnam par shar ba yin nam snyam na/ de ltar ma yin/ yin pa la yin par mthong ba yin/ du ba'i snang bar ma zad chos dbyings de 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi snang ba can yin/ de'i phyir rnam pa thams cad pa'i stong gzugs dang*/ rnam pa kun ldan gyi stong gzug zhes bya/ de rnam pa thams cad pa yin kyang da lta rnal 'byor las dang po pa rnams kyi sems sgrib pas bsgribs te/ rnam pa thams cad pa'i rnam pa gzhan rnams ma mthong*/ ma rig ma shes ma rtogs pa yin/ sa rlung cung zad dbu mar zlog pas chos nyid de du ba'i rnam par yod pa'i phyogs nas cung zad mthong ba lags so/ /de na phyi nang snod bcud kyi snang ba sna tshogs pa 'di rnams kyi nang na sa khams kyis bsdus pa'i chos ji snyed pa zhig 'dug la/ de thams cad 'khrul ngor don byed nus pa yin kyang 'khrul ngo tsam yin gyi/

dngos po'i gnas tshul la grub pa med/ de rnams yod ma myong yang de dag gi thad nas khams kyi chos nyid ye shes de yod/ de rnam pa thams cad pa yin kyang de'i nang nas da lta du ba'i rnam pa de mthong ba yin/ des na du ba'i rtags las gzhan pa'i sa khams kyi chos med ces brjod/ de yang 'jig rten kun rdzob kyi snang ngo dang bstun nas dper brjod na/ me long la snod bcud kyi gzugs brnyan shar ba'i dus na ljon shing gi gzugs brnyan ljon shing dngos su snang*/ ri'i gzugs brnyan ri dngos su snang ste/ ljon shing dang ri de dag me long gi ngos brdar brdar po dang rnam pa ye mi 'dra bar/ me long las tha dad par snang yang blo 'khrul ba'i snang ba yin/ snod bcud kyi gzugs brnyan de rnams me long las logs su med/ me long yang yin la ri dang shing la sogs pa yin pa'ang de na med pas/ me long dang ngo bo yang gcig tu med/ mdor na de na ri dang shing la sogs pa rdzas su grub pa zhig yod na/ de me long dang gcig dang tha dad gang rung du grub dgos kyang*/ gzugs brnyan de dag rgyu rkyen tshogs pa'i 'khrul snang tsam ma gtogs dngos gnas la med pa'i phyir gcig dang tha dad gang du yang mi brjod do/ /me long dang gzugs brnyan gcig dang tha dad gang du yang ma grub cing*/ gzugs brnyan rnams dngos gnas la med mod kyang gzugs brnyan de dag 'char ba'i gzhi me long tsam zhig yod do/ /des na me long las/ gzhan gzugs brnyan med do zhes brda sbyor ba 'dra ste/ me long ni sa khams kyi chos nyid stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po'i du snang gi dpe yin la gzugs brnyan ni sa khams kyis bsdus pa'i las snang rnams kyi dpe yin te/ las snang gi sa khams 'di rnams med bzhin du snang ba'i 'khrul snang yin pas/ ye shes du ba'i rnam pa can dang gcig tu yang ma btub/ tha dad du yang ma btub pa yin la/ ye shes de ni gdod ma nas gnas pa lam bsgoms pas cung zad mthong ba yin no/

/de tsam zhig mtshon byed du byas nas thams cad la sbyar bar bya ste/ smig sgyu'i rtags ni chu khams kyi chos nyid chu khams thams cad pa yin/ mkha' snang gi rtags ni me khams kyi chos nyid me khams thams cad pa yin/ mar me'i rtags ni rlung khams kyi chos nyid rlung khams thams cad pa yin/ thig le'i rtags ni mkha' khams kyi chos nyid mkha' khams thams cad pa yin/ de bzhin du smig sgyu'i rtags las gzhan pa'i chu khams kyi chos med ces pa nas/ thig le'i rtags las gzhan pa'i mkha' khams kyi chos med ces sbyar te/ rtags gzhan lnga la'ang de dang 'dra'o/ /yang 'ga' zhig gi bsam pa la/ du ba ni sa khams kho na'i chos nyid yin pas chu la sogs pa ma yin la/ de bzh-in du smig sgyu ni chu khams kho na'i chos nyid yin pa sogs chos nyid rnam pa du mar 'gyur ro snyam pa 'byung ste/ 'di la brjod pa/ du mar snang yang du ma min/ /gcig pa'i rnam gzhag byed mod kyang*/ /gcig dang tha dad la sogs pa/ /spros pa'i mtshan ma kun las grol/ /zhes bya ba yin pas/ rnal 'byor pa'i blo ngo la rtags bcu tha dad du 'char te/ tha dad du snang ba'i cha nas 'khrul pa yin/ rang bzhin dbye ba med pas rtags bcu ngo bo gcig ces tha snyad bya la/ don dam par gcig dang tha dad gang yang gzhag tu med mod/ du snang de ka smig sgyu'i rtags yin pa la sogs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis gcig pa'i rnam gzhag byas kyang rnam gzhag 'thad ldan yin/ mdor na du bar snang ba ma 'khrul ba nas thig ler snang ba'i bar ma 'khrul ba'i shes pa yin/ du bar snang ba de rnam pa thams cad pa yin kyang*/ smig sgyu la sogs par mi snang ba'i cha nas 'khrul pa yin la/ spyir ni rtags bcu tha dad par 'dzin pa sogs ni du bar snang ba'i ye shes des 'dzin pa ma yin gyi/ rjesakyi rtog pas 'dzin pa yin la/ rtogs pa thams cad ni 'khrul ba yin par thams cad du grags shing grub bo/ /'o na chos nyid la dbye ba med na/

sa'i chos nyid du ba/ chu'i chos nyid smig sgyu zhes sogs so sor sbyor ba ci yin snyam pa 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de la brjod pa/ chos nyid la ngo bos dbye ba med kyang*/ rnam gzhag 'jog pa'i tshe ldog cha tsam gyi dbye bas kun rdzob kyi snang ba tha dad pa'i chos nyid du 'jog pa la 'gal ba med cing*/ don gyi snying po ni 'di lta bu yin te/ chos dbyings gcig nyid rnam pa thams cad pa yin pa las/ du ba'i rnam pa yin pa'i cha la sems can rnams ma rig pa'i 'khrul pa zhugs pa las sa khams las snang gi snang ba sna tshogs 'char ba yin la/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ chos nyid thig le'i rnam par snang ba'i cha la/ sems can rnams nyid kyis rang gi rang bzhin ma shes shing 'khrul pa'i ma rig pa zhugs pa las tha mal las snang mkha' khams kyi snang ba shar ba'i bar du yin no/ /des na sa khams ni chos nyid kyi du ba'i rnam pa la 'khrul ba'i cha nas bzung ste/ mkha' khams ni chos nyid thig le'i rnam pa la 'khrul ba'i bar kyi snang ba yin pas/ rtags bcu ni sa khams sogs de dang de'i chos nyid du 'jog pa yin zhing*/ 'dir so sor sdud pa la sogs pa'i lam bsgoms pas kyang tha mal la 'khrul ba sna tshogs pa skye ba'i rgyu las rlung rnams kyi nang nas sa khams kyi las rlung cung zad zin pas sngar sa khams kho rang chos nyid du ba'i rnam pa la log par zhugs pa'i 'khrul snang yin pa las 'khrul snang gi rgyu rlung cung zad nyams pas/ sa khams kyi 'khrul snang cung zad chung ngu song nas/ chos nyid kyi rnam pa rnams kyi nang nas du ba'i rnam pa cung zad mthong ba yin no/ des na sor sdud kyi rnal 'byor pa las dang po pas mthong ba'i du ba'i rtags de rtags kho rang gi dngos gnas la rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs rnam pa thams cad pa 'khor 'das srid zhi'i chos thams cad kyi rnam pa can du gnas pa yin kyang*/ rnal 'byor pa'i shes rgyud las dang po par song bas/

rnam pa gzhan rnams ma mthong zhing*/ du ba'i rnam pa kho na mthong ba yin no/ de bzhin du rtags bcu thams cad la sbyar bar bya'o/ /des na rtags bcu 'di rnams chos thams cad kyi chos nyid dam dwangs ma yin kyang*/ rtsa rlung thig le'i dwangs ma'i rang gzugs yin no zhes brjod dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni byed bcings dang dmigs pa'i gnad khyad par can la brten nas 'byung ba lnga'i rang bzh-in can gyi rtsa rlung thig le rnams la gnad du bsnun pa'i rkyen gyis mthong bar 'gyur gyi/ dngos po gzhan la gnad du bsnun pa'i thabs med pas rtsa rlung thig le'i sgos kyi dwangs ma yin tshul du bcos nas bshad pa yin no/ /chos thams cad kyi chos nyid yin pa'i tshul las brtsams te ngo sprad pa ste/ ngo sprod skor gsum pa'o/ /gzhan yang du sogs rtags rnams snod bcud kyi chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin yin pa dang*/ rtsa khams rnams kyi dwangs ma yin pa dang*/ chos dbyings ye shes yin pa dang*/ sbyang gzhi chos nyid yin pa dang*/ kun gzhi dge ba yin pa dang*/ don dam pa'i lha sngags thams cad pa yin pa dang*/ don dam pa'i sangs rgyas yin pa'i phyi rim pa bzhin du 'di bsgoms pas zhing thams cad sbyangs par 'gyur zhing*/ sems can thams cad yongs su smin par byas par 'gyur ba dang*/ rdo rje'i lus kyi rtsa khams thig le thams cad dag par 'gyur ba dang*/ 'di bsgoms pas dkar po'i chos thams cad bsgoms par 'gyur ba dang*/ 'di'i steng gi dri ma dag na sgrib pa thams cad dag par 'gyur ba dang*/ 'di'i sgom pa mthar phyin pas lam thams cad sgom pa mthar phyin par 'gyur ba dang*/ stong gzugs 'di la brtan pa thob cing mthar phyin par 'grub na yi dam gyi lha thams cad 'grub cing*/ sngags 'bras thams cad grub pas las tshogs dang dngaus grub kyi rigs thams cad thob par 'gyur ba dang*/ byang phyogs sogs lam gyi yon tan dang*/ stobs bcu sogs 'bras bu'i yon tan thams cad kyang 'di nyid la rang chas su bzhugs pas/

'di bsgoms pas de thams cad kyang mngon du 'gyur ba yin no/ /rtags bcu mthong ba de ni bde gshegs snying po mthong ba yin la/ bde gshegs snying po'am/ sems nyid dang*/ chos kyi dbyings dang*/ don dam bden pa dang*/ stong pa nyid dang*/ de bzhin nyid dang*/ yang dag pa'i mtha' zhes bya ba yang spros bral rnam pa thams cad pa 'di yin no/ /'di ni chad stong ma yin bem stong ma yin/ med par dgag pa'i mtshan nyid can ma yin/ cir yang ma grub cir yang ma yin pa de la chos nyid zer ba de 'dra'i rigs sgra che la don chung ba de tshan ma yin/ yang dag pa'i rig pa rnam pa thams cad du gdod nas shar ba 'di yin te/ snang med ma yin par rang rig rang gsal rtags bcur shar ba nyams su myong zh-ing mngon sum du grub pa 'di gong du bshad pa ltar rtags dang rgyu mtshan gtso bo lags so/ /'di rnams don dam pa'i sangs rgyas dngos yin pa'i phyir/ stobs sogs sangs rgyas kyi yon tan ma lus pa'ang 'di la rang chas su yod/ rang gis sgom par nus na rim gyis mngon sum du mthong zhing rtogs par 'gyur rnam grangs nye tshe tsam brjod na/ 'di la mnyam par bzhag pas mi dge ba'i rnam rtog thams cad 'gag /dad pa dang snying rje la sogs pa dge ba'i chos kyi rnam pa rnams dmigs rnam logs su ched kyi ma bsgoms kyang rang shugs su 'char lus ngag gi 'jug ldog khyad par can shugs la 'byung*/ 'dzag med kyi tshul khrims kyang myur du thob pas don dam 'od gsal kyis snang ba 'di ka lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa dang don dam pa'i 'dul ba yin/ rtog dpyod can dang rtog med dpyod tsam dang*/ rtog dpyod gnyis ka spangs pa dang*/ dga' ba can dang*/ bde ba can dang*/ btang snyoms kho na can dang*/ gsal stong bde ba'i nyams sna tshogs dang*/ 'du shes dang yid la byed pa mtha' yas pa'i rnam pa can dang*/ zad par la sogs pa'i snang ba mtha' yas pa 'char zhing*/

rin chen snang ba dang zla ba sgron ma la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin brgya nyi shu la sogs pa thams cad kyang 'di la mnyam par bzhag na myur du thob pa'i phyir/ don dam pa'i mdo sde dang lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa yin/ 'di nyid chos thams cad kyi chos nyid yin zhing*/ 'd-i'i steng na gzung 'dzin gyi snang ba nub/ rnam rtog 'gags/ ye shes kyi snang ba gsal por 'char ba mngon sum du grub pa'i phyir na don dam pa'i mngon pa dang*/ lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa yin/ de bzhin du chos dbyings yin pa'i phyir chos kyi sku yin la/ chos sku yin pa'i phyir don dam pa'i sangs rgyas dkon mchog yin/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes yin pa'i phyir chos dkon mchog gi snying po'am mchog yin/ chos kyi gnas lugs yin pa'i phyir 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyi rtogs bya yin pas/ gang zhig rtogs pas rab tu phye ba'i don dam pa'i dge 'dun yang 'di yin no/ /gzhan yang 'od gsal gyi rtags snang 'di rnams la mnyam par bzhag pas ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i shes bya rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab ngang gis skye bar 'gyur te/ 'di don dam pa'i dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi ru gnas pa'i rtags yin/ brtson 'grus ngang gis skye ste/ don dam pa'i yang dag spong ba bzhi yin pa'i rtags yin/ de sogs lam gyi chos thams cad dang sbyar/ 'di la mnyam par bzhag pas nyon mongs rang byung gi nyams dang rnam rtog rang byung gi nyams sna tshogs pa 'char/ de ni nyon mongs la sogs pa'i chos nyid yin pa'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ don dam pa'i 'dod chags dang zhe sdang la sogs pa'i rnam pa mthong ba yin/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi gnas lus longs spyod sogs kyi snang ba sna tshogs 'char/ de ni khams gsum gyi chos nyid yin pa'i rtags dang*/ don dam pa'i lha dang*/ don dam pa'i dmyal ba dang*/ don dam gyi mi la sogs par rang chas su bzhugs pa'i rtags yin/

yi dam lha dang sangs rgyas rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs mang po mthong*/ de ni don dam bde gshegs snying po mtshan dpe la sogs pa yon tan du mas brgyan par bzhugs pa'i rtags dang*/ rnam pa thams cad pa'i nang nas dag pa'i snang bar bzhugs pa'i rtags yin/ gzhan yang mngon shes la sogs pa dang*/ spros bral dang*/ stong nyid la sogs pa'i rnam pa gzhan dang*/ sems can gyi don shes pa la sogs pa nyams gyi tshul du 'char te/ de ni stong gzugs zhes kyang bya/ /sems nyid ces kyang bya/ don dam bden pa zhes kyang bya ba 'di gdod ma nas ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang*/ mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi ngo bor rtag tu gdod nas yod pa dang*/ sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi rnam pa mtha' yas par ye nas bzhugs shing*/ bzhugs pa ltar rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi mig gis ci rigs par mthong ba yin no/ /de ltar na stong gzugs bsgoms pas zhing sbyangs par 'gyur tshul nas 'di'i bar du brjod pa rnams kyi don rgya cher bshad na ngo sprod mtha' yas par 'gyur mod kyi/ yi ge mangs pas 'jigs pa'i phyir dang*/ nyams myong dang bstun nas bshad dgos pa yi ger 'god mi lang ba'i phyir dang*/ phyogs tsam smros pa 'dis go zhing ston par 'gyur pa'i phyir/ mdo tsam 'di las ma bstan to/ /de dag gis ni chos thams cad stong gzugs su 'dus par ngo sprad pa ste/ ngo sprod skor bzhi pa'o/ /de nas chos thams cad stong pa nyid du ngo sprod pa la/ stong nyid chos kun gyi gzhi yin par bstan/ rang bzhin gdod nas spros bral du gtan la phab/ don dam bsal bzhag med pa'i gnas la nges pa bskyed pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rnam pa thams cad pa'i stong nyid ye shes 'di ga 'bras bu'i mthar thug rgyal ba rigs lnga rigs drug ye shes lnga'am ye shes drug sogs gdod ma nas yin pa'i gnad kyi sems nyid gcig pu 'bras bu'i chos thams cad du shar/

gzhi 'bras dbye ba med pa'i gnad kyis sems nyid gcig pu gzhi 'bras gnyis ka dang rnam pa mthun pa'i lam gyi chos thams cad du shar/ de bzhin du sems nyid gcig pu'i dri ma bag chags kyi snang cha las/ gzhi 'khor ba'i chos thams cad shar te/ nang bcud kyi sems can rdo rje lus kyi snang tshul mtha' yas pa dang*/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten rnam pa sna tshogs pa 'di dag shar ba yin pas/ mdor na ye shes gcig nyid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad du sprul pa'am/ gcig nyid du mar shar yang du ma gcig gi rang bzhin las ma 'das zhes bya/ gong du'ang don gyis na bshad mod kyi/ 'dir sngar las cung zad gsal bar brjod na/ sems nyid rnam pa thams cad pa'i 'char tshul la 'khor ba'i chos dang mtshungs pa'i lha dang dmyal ba la sogs pa'i rnam pa de kun rdzob kyi rnam pa ma yin/ don dam pa'i rnam pa yin/ sbyang bya ma yin/ sbyang gzhi yin/ dag bya ma yin/ dag gzhi yin/ chos can ma yin/ chos nyid yin la/ kun rdzob las snang gi lha dang dmyal ba rnams ni don du ma grub sems snang yin/ don dam gyi rnam pa ma yin kun rdzob kyi rnam pa yin/ sbyang gzhi ma yin sbyang bya yin/ dag gzhi ma yin dag bya yin/ chos nyid ma yin chos can yin/ 'dis mtshon nas don dam pa'i srid gsum gyi snang ba thams cad gnas lugs yin zhing*/ kun rdzob srid gsum gyi snang ba thams cad glo bur gyi dri ma yin no/ /de bzhin du sems nyid kyi rang bzhin la dad pa dang snying rje dang shes rab la sogs pa'i rnam pa gdod nas gnas pa de ni don dam dang sbyang gzhi sogs yin la/ lam dang rtsol bas gsar du bskyed pa'i dad pa dang snying rje dag shes rab la sogs pa rnams ni kun rdzob dang byed kyi lam yin gyi/ don dam dang dag gzhi la sogs pa ma yin no/ /lam gyi chos 'di dag gzhi/ dag bya/ dag byed/ dag 'bras bzhi 'am/ sbyang gzhi/ sbyang bya/ sbyong byed/

sbyangs 'bras bzhis zlas phye ba'i sbyong byed dang*/ dag byed kho na yin kyang*/ sbyang gzh-i sbyang bya gnyis su chos thams cad bsdu ba'i tshai/ lam dus kyi shes rab la sogs pa lam gyi ngo bo de rnams ni kun rdzob pa'i chos kho na yin pa'i phyir dang*/ rim gyis 'dor dgos pa'i phyir sbyang bya'i phyogs su bsdu la/ shes rab kyi steng gi chos yang dag par 'byed pa'i ye shes nang rig tsam gyi ldog cha sogs ni sbyang gzhi'i nang du bsdu ste/ de lta ba'i rigs rgyun nam du yang mi ldog pa dang*/ kun rdzob kho na nyid ma yin par don dam dang mthun zhing*/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i lam bden gdul bya gzhan snang du 'gro ba'i don spyod pa'i ye shes de'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis su kha tshon gcod pa'i skabs 'dir/ gzhi 'bras ngo bo dbye ba med pa'i gnad kyis sbyangs 'bras thams cad kyang sbyang gzhir bsdu'o/ /sems kyi rang bzhin la stobs sogs sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi rnam pa sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyis bsdus pa thams cad ni don dam dang sbyang gzhi sogs yin la/ lam bsgom pas gsar du thob pa'i ldog cha glo bur gyi dri ma spangs pa'i cha rnams dang*/ gdul bya gzhan snang du ston pa rnams dang*/ gzhan snang du 'char du rung ba rnams ni kun rdzob dang sbyangs 'bras yin zhing sbyang gzhi ma yin no/ /dag pa gnyis ldan gyi skabs kyi rang bzhin rnam dag gi cha de ni sbyang gzhi sbyangs 'bras gnyis kar yin pa lta smos kyang ci dgos kyi/ gzhi'i chos nyid ces bya ba dang*/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum spyi'i chos nyid ces brjod kyang rung ste/ gdod ma'i sems nyid de ga sbyangs 'bras mthar thug dang don dam pa'i sbyangs 'bras yin no/ /yang 'dir log rtog 'di lta ste/ de ltar na sems rnam pa thams cad pa'i srid pa gsum gyi rnam pa las ni 'khor ba 'byung gi gzhan gnyis mi 'byung la/

shes rab kyi rnam pa sogs las gzhan gnyis 'byung zhing 'khor ba mi 'byung zhing*/ ye shes lnga'i rnam pa sogs las gzhi lam gnyis mi 'byung bas rnam pa so so tha dad pa rnams byed las tha dad par nges shing*/ byed las tha dad pas ngo bo yang tha dad par 'gyur la/ de'i phyir du ma'i rang bzhin can kun rdzob pa brdzun pa bslu ba'i chos can yin no snyam pa 'ga' zhig gi bsam pa la 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de la brjod pa bden te rnam par rtog pa 'di ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas khong du ma chud par zad do/ /'on kyang skyon de ltar mi 'jug ste/ 'dir don dam pa dmyal ba'i rnam pa gang yin pa de ka snying rje'i rnam pa dang shes rab kyi rnam pa'ang yin la/ de nyid me long ye shes la sogs pa'i rnam pa'ang yin no/ /de ltar na rnam pa mang po so so tha dad pa dus gcig tu shing la 'bras bu mang po chags pa bzh-in du ldan pa ma yin gyi/ rnam pa thams cad ngo bo gcig pa'i tshul gyis gnas pa yin pas/ rnam pa kun ldan dang rnam pa thams cad pa dang dbang po thams cad pa zhes brjod pa yin gyi/ rnam pa tha dad pa dang*/ rnam pa so so ba dang*/ dbang po so so ba zhes brjod pa ma yin no/ /des na rnam ba kun ldan gcig pu gnyis su med pa yin kyang*/ don dam pa'i dmyal ba'i rnam pa sogs yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ de'i g.ya' lta bur chags pa'i dri ma la dmyal sogs 'khor ba'i snang ba 'char ba yin zhing*/ de nyid shes rab la sogs pa'i rnam pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis sgrub pa po'i rgyud la shes rab sogs lam gyi chos thams cad 'char ba yin te/ sa 'og na rdo sol dag chu tshan yod na sa steng gi sa rlan can yang dros nas sa'i steng la rlangs pa byung ba lta bu yin zhing*/ de nyid me long ye shes la sogs pa'i rnam pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis nor bu las nor bu'i 'od 'byung ba ltar sangs rgyas rnams la sku gsum mdzad pa dang bcas pa 'char ba yin

no/ /de yang don dam dbyings las gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos thams cad 'char ba ni/ don dam dbyings te don dam pa'i rnam pa thams cad pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'khor ba pa dang rnal 'byor pa la dag pa dang ma dag pa'i kun rdzob kyi rnam pa thams cad par shar ba yin la/ sangs rgyas rnams kyang gzhan snang du kun rdzob pa'i rnam pa thams cad par ston pa yin no/ /rnam pa thams cad pa'i dpe sman sna tshogs bsdus pa'i gam thang gi dpe dang sbyar ro/ /gzhan yang dper na/ phyogs bzhi las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal po lha chain po zhes pa de mi mang po 'dus pa min gyi mi gcig nyid yin/ des phyogs bzhi'i yul mi la bka' lung stsal pas phyogs bzhi'i yul la dbang bsgyur ba yin/ de'i tshe shar phyogs la bka' lung ster ba po shar phyogs la dbang bsgyur ba de ka lho phyogs la dbang bsgyur ba po dang bka' stsol pa bo yin mod/ don la shar gyi mi la bka' stsol ba po lho la dbang bsgyur mkhan yin kyang shar pa rnams la bka' stsal ba'i byed pa'i lho phyogs dbang bsgyur zhes mi brjod pa bzhin du don dam dbyings kyi don dam pa'i bum pa'i rnam pa gcig pu las gzhi las 'bras bu thams cad kyi snang ba byung ba shin tu yin kyang don dam bum pa'i rnam pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi bum pa kun rdzob pa'i rnam pa shar/ don dam ka ba'i rnam pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis kun rdzob ka ba'i snang ba 'byung zhes brjod kyi/ don dam bum pa'i rnam pa las kun rdzob ka ba 'byung*/ ka ba las bum pa 'byung zhes sogs mi zer te/ don la 'gal ba med kyang 'jig rten tshul dang mi mthun pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang dper na/ nam mkha' ni gzugs can thams cad kyi go 'byed pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis sprin dang mun pa la sogs pa'ang 'byung bar 'gyur/ rlung dang nyi ma'i 'od la sogs pa'ang 'byung bar 'gyur/ rlung gis sprin bsal/ nyi 'od kyis mun pa bsal ba'i gnas skabs 'ga' na/

bar snang stong sang ngai ba rab rib med pa'i mig shes kyis dngos su mthong ba yang 'byung mod/ sprin dang mun nag dang rlung dang nyi 'od dang bar snang mthong ba'i mig shes rnams kyis nam mkha' la gos pa med cing*/ nam mkha' kyang de rnams bskyed pa ma yin mod kyi/ de rnams skye ba la nam mkhas gegs mi byed cing*/ gegs mi byed pa'i nam mkha' de yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis rkyen nye bar dmigs na de rnams 'byung bas na/ nam mkha' la sprin byung zhes sogs tha snyad 'dogs so/ /de bzhin du sems nyid 'dis gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi kun rdzob kyi chos rnams dngos su bskyed pa ma yin zhing*/ de rnams bskyed pa'i rgyu'ang 'di ma yin la/ de rnams 'byung ba 'di'i byed las kyang yang dag par nam yin mod/ chos nyid 'di rnam pa thams cad pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'khor ba pa dang*/ rnal 'byor pa dang*/ sangs rgyas rnams la de dang de 'byung zhing*/ gnas skabs gsum po de dag tu gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos rnams 'byung ba la sems 'dis mi sgrib cing gegs mi byed la/ de dag gi gzhi rten gyi 'dra mtshungs su yod cing*/ mi sgrib cing gegs mi byed pa'i sems nyid 'di med na de rnams mi 'byung zhing*/ rkyen nye ba na 'di yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de rnams byung bas/ don dam dbyings las kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad skyes so/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos thams cad byung ngo*/ /snang ba sna tshogs pa 'di ni de'i byed las so/ /zhes brda' sbyar ba yin pas rgyu dang 'bras bu dang byed pa po dang byed las su 'jog pa rnams ni phyogs mthun tsam rgyu mtshan du bzhag pa'i btags pa ba yin no/ /de bas na/ yang dag par na don dam ni kun rdzaub dang 'brel ba can ma yin la/ kun rdzaub kyang rang gi ngo bos med pa'i phyir 'brel bar bya rgyu med pas na/ don dam dang 'brel ba med do/ /kun rdzob glo ngor ni don dam chos nyid yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis kun rdzob byung la/

don dam chos nyid med na ni de yang 'byung mi srid pas/ don dam kun rdzob dang ma 'brel yang kun rdzob don dam 'brel zhes brda' sbyar ba yin pa/ 'brel ba de yang btags pa ba yin no/ de ltar na chos nyid de/ rnam pa kun ldan rnam pa med/ /ces bya ba yin bas don dam pa'i rnam pa kun dang ldan/ rnam pa kun tu rang gi ngo bos yod/ rang bzhin gyis grub cing yod pa yin kyang kun rdzaub kyi rnam pa gang du yang med de/ kun rdzob kyi rnam pa thams cad gdod ma nas yod ma myong ba'i phyir ro/ /de lta bu'i chos dbyings rnam pa kun ldan de nyid sems kyi rang bzhin yin pas sems rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba zhes bya/ 'di'i ngo bo ni mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba yin la/ 'di'i rang gzugs ni stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mo yin no/ /'di'i khyad par ni dus gsum kyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir bde gshegs snying po zhes bya ste/ de ltar na/ stong gzugs mthong bas sems nyid mthong*/ chos sku mthong*/ don dam bden pa mthong*/ gnas lugs mthong*/ 'gog bden mthong zhes ngo sprad do/ /stong nyid rnam pa thams cad pa la brten nas chos thams cad kyi gzhi rten du ngo sprad pa ste ngo sprod skor lnga pa'o// //gnyis pa ni/ sems nyid rnam pa thams cad pa de la rnam pa'i ldog cha mtha' yas kyang*/ ngo bo'i sgo nas dbyings bde ba chen po kho nar zad la/ de la gzung 'dzin spros pa'i chos ni gdod ma nas yod ma myong*/ gdod ma'i ye shes kho rang gi rang ngo nas 'khrul ba'i snang ba 'char ba min kyang*/ ye shes de rgyud ldan gyi sems can rnams kyi sems rgyud dam rnam shes sgrib pa'i rang bzhin can yin pas dngos gnas la yod pa'i rang bzhin de mi mthong bar rnam shes rang rig rang gsal tsam la 'khrul pa sna tshogs pa shar ba der gda'/ ngo bo 'khrul pa de'i nang tshan yin kyang 'khrul pa gzhan mang po sel nus shing*/

don dam gyi dbyings de la snying nye zhing 'dun pa'i rnam pa can chos la dad pa dang*/ sems can la snying rje dang*/ rtsol bcas kyi ting nge 'dzin dang*/ gnas lugs la 'jug pa'i shes rab la sogs pa lam gyi chos thams cad kyang rnam shes rang rig rang gsal de'i snang cha la shar nas spang bya glo bur gyi dri ma gzhan rnams rim gyis spong*/ lam gyi chos rnams kyi 'char gzhi rnam shes tsam de yang lam bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis don dam gyi dbyings su thim par byed cing*/ rnam shes de gzung 'dzin gnyis snang dang bcas pa ni sems nyid kyi sgrib g.yog yin pas/ lam gyi gzh-i'i sgrib g.yog de spong bar byed cing*/ lam kho rang yang mthar gtugs na sgrib g.yogs su gtogs kyang*/ sgrib byed gzhan thams cad khos sel/ mthar bud shing zad na me yal ba bzhin du lam nyid kyang rang sangs la 'gro'o/ /de'i tshe kun rdzob kyi sgrib g.yogs thams cad zad pas/ gnas lugs don dam gcig pu nyid khyab brdal du gyur pa ni/ sangs rgyas thob pa dang 'bras bu mthar phyin pa zhais ming btags pa yin no/ /de yang chos dbyings rang ngos nas sgrib g.yogs kyis bsgribs pa'i skabs dang*/ sgrib g.yogs sel bzhin pa'i skabs dang*/ bsal zin pa'i skabs zhes dbye ba med kyang*/ yid can skyes bu rnams kyi blo'i rim pa rnam pa gsum du byung ba yin no/ /ri rab kyi drung na gnas pa'i long ba'i dus dang mig phye ba'i dus kyi dpe dang sbyar ro/ /de ltar yang*/ khams ni gnas skabs gsum dag tu/ /mi gsum gyi ni bstan pa yin/ /zhes dbyings kyi rang bzhin rtogs dka' bas de rgyud ldan gyi gang zag de'i gnas skabs gsum la tha snyad gdags pa rnam par gzhag pa mdzad nas dbyings de go bar byed pa yin pas/ gnas lugs la 'jug pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ltar 'char sgo gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi chos mtha' dag dang*/ kun khyab chos dbyings de bzhin nyid ni skabs 'dir khyad gzhir bzhag nas/

de dag spros bral du gtan la dbab pa ni/ spros pa dang bral ba dang spros pa med pa zhes bya ba la gang zhig bral rgyu dang su zhig med rgyu'i spros pa ni/ yul dang yul can nam/ shes pa dang shes bya'am/ rtogs bya dang rtogs byed dam/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa dang*/ che chung dang*/ bzang ngan dang*/ mtha' dbus la sogs pa dang*/ shar la sogs pa'i phyogs cha dang*/ 'das ma 'ongs da ltar la sogs pa dus kyi cha dang*/ phyi nang bar gsum la sogs pa gnas kyi cha dang*/ skye 'gag gnas gsum la sogs pa ngo bo'i char 'khrul zhing snang la sgro 'dogs shing 'dzin pa rnams te/ spros pa de dag kyang med bzhin du blos btags pa/ ming tsam brda tsam ma btags gcig pu nyams dga' ba'i tshul du yod yod ltar snang kyang dngos po'i gshis dang gnas tshul la yod ma myong*/ de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas kyis kyang med par gsungs/ bsam byung gi shes rab kyis kyang brtags na mi rnyed/ sgom byung gi shes rab kyis kyang med par rtogs/ 'phags pa rnams kyis ci yang gzigs ma myong ba zhig yin pas/ khyad gzhi kun rdzaub don dam gnyis ka la khyad chos spraus pa de dag gdod ma nas med pa lags so/ /gdod ma nas grub ma myong ba yin no/ /spros pa de rnams re re nas med tshul ni 'dir mi 'bri ste/ bshad kyi mi lang ba'i phyir dang*/ go ba rags pa tsam ni skye sla ba'i phyir dang*/ rigs pa phra mo rnams ni phal gyis go dka' ba'i phyir dang*/ sgaum ngo sprod pa'i dus su 'thad sgrub kyi rigs pa ni skabs kyi don ma yin pa'i phyir dang*/ 'di theg chen gyi mdo sngags thams cad la grags pa'i thun mong yin pa'i phyir dang*/ gzhan du btsal bas rnyed par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad par 'di ltar shes par bya ste/ kun rdzob snang grags kyi bsdus pa'i chos 'di rnams yul yul can/ che chung mtha' dbus/ skye 'gag gnas gsum la sogs par ma grub/

de ma grub pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis snang grags 'di rnams 'khrul snang la shar ba ma gtogs med pa yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan skye 'gags gnas gsum du snang ba 'di yod na skye 'gag gnas gsum du ka sgrub dgos pa las/ skye 'gag gnas gsum ye ma grub pas skye 'gag gnas gsum du snang ba 'di 'khrul snang kho na nyid yin par shes/ yul yul can sogs gzhan thams cad la'ang skye 'gag gnas gsum gyi rigs 'gre/ don dam chos kyi dbyings la yul yul can/ che chung mtha' dbus skye 'gag gnas gsum la sogs pa gang yang med mod de rnams med pas don dam la spros pa'i chos gang yang med pa yin kyang don dam med par mi 'gyur/ de'i rgyu mtshan sngar kun rdzob kyi skabs dang mi 'dra/ kun rdzob gyi chos gcig yod phyin spros pa'i mtshan ma gang rung zhig tu yod dgos/ de med pas de yang med/ don dam dbyings ni yod kyang spros pa'i mtshan ma de dag gi ngo bor yod mi dgos pas/ de dag med kyang don dam pa med par mi 'gyur/ dper na skye ba zhes bya ba gtan nas med na skye bar snang zhing myong ba de 'khrul snang kho na yin par thags chod kyang don dam dbyings de skye bar snang ba'i chos min pas/ skye ba gtan nas ma grub kyang don dam dbyings med par mi 'grub pa yin no/ /don dam dbyings de yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gzhan/ ji skad du/ gzhan min phyin ci log ma yin/ /de 'gags 'phags pa'i spyod yul dang*/ / 'phags pa'i chos kyi rgyu yi phyir/ /zhes gsungs pa sogs lung dang rigs pa dang man ngag dang nyams myong ste tshad ma bzhi'i sgo nas gnas lugs la bzhugs par grub bo/ /sgo drung na skyes bu lhas byin yod pa la ba lang yod par 'khrul zhing*/ dngos su mthong ba na 'khrul pa sangs pa'i dpe dang sbyar ro/ /kun rdzaub snang grags kyi chos thamasacad kyang skye med 'gag med gnas med yin/ yul med/ yul can med/

gang zag med/ chos bdag med pa yin/ don dam dbyings kyang skye med 'gag med gnas med yin/ yul med yul can med/ gang zag med/ chos bdag med pa yin/ de ltar yin yang snang grags kyi chos 'di rnams nam du yang med la/ don dam dbyings ni gnas tshul la yod cing rtag brtan zhi ba g.yung drung du bzhugs pa yin no/ /'dir chos dbyings la ngo sprod tshul ni/ rnal 'byor pas mthong ba'i stong gzugs la rnal 'byor pas blo ngor skye 'gag gnas gsum du snang ba 'khrul ba yin pas/ skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i 'dus ma byas su ngo sprod pa dang gcig sems gsal rig la'ang skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba sogs de ltar ngo sprod pa dang gnyis/ stong gzugs dang sems gnyis yul yul can tha dad par blos 'dzin pa 'di 'khrul snang yin pas/ gnas lugs la stong gzugs nyid sems/ sems nyid stong gzugs dbyer med ngo bo gcig yin la/ de nyid yod med yin min bzang ngan che chung sogs sgra rtog gang gis kyang ma reg pa'i blo 'das su ngo sprad pa ste/ gsum gyi gnad nas bzung ste ngo sprod pa ste ngo sprod gsum mo/ /kun rdzob snang ba la ngo sprod pa la yang gzugs snang lta bu gcig gi steng du sbyar na/ gzugs snang spros bral/ gzugs 'dzin shes pa spros bral/ snang sems dbyer med spros bral te phal cher gong mas rigs 'gre la/ 'on kyang stong gzugs dang sems nyid ye shes dbyer med 'dus ma byas yin la/ las snang dang rnam shes gsal rig dbyer med 'dus byas yin pa'i khyad par phyed dgos la/ las snang dang rnam shes gnyis rnal 'byor pa'i yang dag kun rdzob bden pa'i don yul yul can dbyer med du ngo sprad pas rnam shes la gzung cha dang 'dzin cha dbye ba med pa dang*/ rnam shes tsam zhig tha snyad bden par yod/ gzhan dbang de la kun brtags med par ngo sprad pa yin/ don dam par las snang dang rnam shes gnyis ka gdod nas ma grub pas/

de nyid dang gzhan du brjod du med pa yin zhing*/ stong gzugs dang sems nyid ngo bo gcig pa nyid yin kyang 'khrul ngor gnyis snang shar mod kyang dbyer med du gtan la 'bebs pa ni/ yongs grub la gzhan dbang kun brtags gzung 'dzin gyi gdod nas gos ma myong bar ngo sprod pa yin zhing*/ bden pa gnyis po yang ngo bo de nyid dang gzhan du brjod du med pa yin no/ /de ltar na/ las snang gi de kun rdzaub bden pa la ngo sprod pa yin zhing*/ stong gzugs kyi de don dam gyi gnas lugs la ngo spraud pa yin no/ /rang bzhin spros bral la ngo sprad pa ste ngo sprod skor drug pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyi myang 'das yin/ rang bzh-in gyi myang 'das las gzhan pa'i chos med/ 'khor ba'i chos thams cad med bzhin snang ba'i cho 'phrul yin/ des na gshis lugs la 'khor ba yod ma myong*/ de la sems las nyon mongs mngon sum du skyes/ nyon mongs sna tshogs kyis las sna tshogs bsags/ de las sdug bsngal sna tshogs thog tu babs pa myong bas grub/ lung dang rig pas kyang grub po snyam pa dang*/ de nas lam bsgoms pas las nyon sdug bsngal gsum po je chung je chung du 'gro zhing*/ yon tan gyi chos rnams je mang je cher 'gro ba myong bas grub pa dang*/ nam zhig 'bras bu mngon du gyur pa'i tshe sngar yod 'khor ba'i skyon thams cad dus der zad/ sngar med kyi yon tan thams cad gsar du thob par yang rigs pas 'thob pa yin pas 'khor ba gdod nas med pa sogs mi rung ngo snyam na/ de lta bu'i 'khor ba dang lam dang 'bras bu'i rim pa de dag kyang blo 'khrul ba'i snang ngo kho na yin/ 'khor ba'i chos thams cad yod ma myong yang rab rib can gyi sa nam mkha' la skra shad mthong ba bzhin du 'khrul te snang*/ lam bsgoms pas skyon yon spang thob ltar snang ba yang dper na mig rab rib can gyis thag ring thung 'tshams pa'i ri bo'i ngos la bltas na/

ri'i ngos na yod pa'i rtsa dang shing gel ba dang ri dwags la sogs pa gang yang mi mthong ngo*/ /ri'i ngos la dngos gnas la med kyang skra shad dang 'od zlum po dang*/ dra ba'i rnam pa can la sogs pa rab rib kyi gzugs brnyan ji snyed cig mthong bar 'gyur na/ mig sman bsten pa la sogs pas rab rib de ji chung je chung du song ba'i tshe ri'i ngos la skra shad la sogs pa je nyung du song ba dang*/ shing gel ba la sogs pa je mang du song ba ltar snang ngo*/ /des na ri ni sems kyi dpe/ skra shad sogs ni las nyon sdug bsngal gsum gyi dpe/ rtswa shing sogs ni yon tan gyi dpe'o/ /skra shad sogs sngon nas yod ma myong bas phyis nyung du 'gro rgyu med/ mig gi skyon dag pas 'khrul pa sangs pa tsam yin/ rtswa shing sogs sngar las mang du song ba ma yin/ sngar sgrib byed kyis bsgribs nas ma mthong ba de gsar du mthong ba yin/ de bzh-in du 'khor ba'i chos gnas tshul la ma grub pas je nyung du 'gro rgyu med kyang 'khrul pa je chung du song ba tsam yin/ yon tan gyi chos sems la gdod ma nas gnas pa yin pas na gsar du skye ba dang je mang du 'gro rgyu med kyang sngar sgrib pas bsgribs nas ma mthong ba sgrib byed je srab tu song bas mthong tshul rgya je cher song ba yin/ rab rib sangs pa'i tshe skra shad sogs ye ma mthong zhing rtswa shing sogs kyis khyab par mthong yang*/ skra shad bsal ba dag rtsa shing sogs gsar du skyes pa ma yin pa bzhin du sangs rgyas thob pa'i tshe 'khor ba gtan nas med cing*/ sems nyid mkha' khyab yon tan thams cad kyi rang bzh-in du mngon du gyur pa yang 'khor ba bsal rgyu dang*/ yon tan gsar skyes min te/ rang sems la gdod ma nas gnas pa'i yon tan rnams 'khrul pa zad pas mngon sum du mthong ba tsam ni yin no/ ji skad du/ gnyis las gzhan med de ni nor pa skyes/ /de phyir thar pa nor tsam zad pa yin/

/zhes gsungs/ de nyid la bsal bzhag med pa'i don zhes bya ste/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ /bzhag par bya ba cung zad med/ /ces so/ /bsal bzhag med pa'i dpe gzhan yang rdzing bu don gnyer gyi mi mtshan mo lam du zhugs pas rdzing bu la rdo stegs su 'khrul/ nam langs pa na rdzing bur shes kyang rdo stegs bsal du med/ rdz-ing bu bzhag tu med pa dang*/ dung ser por snang ba sogs dang sbyar ro/ /skabs 'dir sgom nyams skad cig ma'i staing du sbyar na stong gzugs dang bde gsal gyi nyams shig shar/ de rang bzh-in gyi myang 'das yin/ gsar du bzhag pa ma yin/ gdod ma'i gnas lugs yin/ rang la ye nas yod yod pa yin kyang man ngag tshad ma dang ma mjal bar du gang zag rang gis ma myong ba yin/ ma rtog pa yin/ mngon du ma gyur pa yin/ da ni byed bcings la sogs pa thabs khyad par can gyis cung zad mthong ba yin/ gsal stong bde ba'i nyams shar ba'i skabs de nyid na bzang ngo ngan no bde'o mi bde'o snyam pa'i rnam rtog cig thol gyis 'char/ de yud tsam zhig gnas/ dar cig nas de log ste yang rtog pa gzhan skye ba la sogs par snang*/ de ltar rtog pa skye 'gag gnas gsum du snang ba de 'khrul pa yin/ de nyid rang zhal la bltas pas gang nas skyes/ gang du gnas/ ji ltar 'gag ces brda sbyar bas yul gang na yang mi 'dug gnas gang du yang mi gnas/ dus nam gyi tshe yang ma dmigs/ rnam pa ji lta bur yang mi 'char/ ngo bo gang du yang ma grub/ des na rnam rtog de gdod ma nas yod ma myong*/ de phyir yod pa ltar snang ba 'khrul snang tsam yin/ gdod nas med pa la su zhig skye/ su zhig gnas/ su zhig 'gag /rnam rtog 'di 'khor ba yin/ glo bur ba yin/ med bzhin du snang ba yin/ des na rnam rtog phar bsal du med/ gsal stong bde ba tshur bzhag tu med pas gnas lugs la bsam bzhag med pa zhes bya/ des gzhan thams cad la rigs 'gre'o/ /don dam bsal bzhag med pa'i don la ngo sprad pa ste/

ngo sprod skor bdun pa'o/ /da ni de dag gi 'phros don rnams bshad par bya ste/ gong du bshad pa de dag ni yan lag drug po'i gnas skabs thams cad du rtogs par bya dgos pa yin la/ 'on kyang sor sdud kyi skabs su rtags snang mthong ba tsam la ngo sprad pa gtso che zhing*/ bsam gtan gyi skabs su spros bral dang*/ bsal bzhag med par ngo sprod pa gal che/ srog rtsol gyi skabs su ni/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i bdag nyid stong gzugs dang sems nyid dbyer med pa de rtsa dang rlung gi chos nyid dam/ don dam pa'i rtsa dang rlung du ngo sprad nas/ gsal stong gi ting nge 'dzin gtso bor skyong dgos/ rtsa'i rang bzhin gsal ba dang rlung gi rang bzhin stong pa yin no/ /ro rkyang gi rlung ni 'khrul ba'i rang bzhin yin pas/ /ma 'khrul pa'i ye shes 'od gsal rtags nang de nyid kyi ngang du rlung bcu rengs par gyur pa ni/ rlung dbu mar chud pa zhes bya ba yin te/ rtags snang nyid dbu ma'i ye shes kyi rlung dang dbye ba med pa yin no/ /'dzin pa'i skabs su thig le'i rang bzhin bde ba yin la/ bde ba de dang rtags snang ngo bo dbyer med pa yang dag pa'i gtum mo yin par ngo sprad nas/ rlung bcu yang bde mnyam gyi ting nge 'dzin der thim par byed dgos pa yin no/ /'dir bde stong gi nyams gtso bor skyong*/ 'di thig le'i rnal 'byor kho na gtso che/ gsal stong bde ba gsum don la dbye ba med kyang tha mal gyi rlung 'di'i dri ma cha shas dag nas/ gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin du shar pa'i tshe/ gsal stong du thim pa zhes bya zhing*/ da dung dri ma ci rigs dag nas bde ba'i ting nge 'dzin du gyur pa'i tshe bde stong la thim pa zhes bya'o/ /des na rtsa rlung thig le dbu mar thim pa zhes bya ba yang*/ de rnams rang rang gi chos nyid kyi gnas su ci rigs par thim pa'i ming yin no/ /des na chaus nyid kyi rtsa rlung thig le rnam pa thams cad pa stong gzugs dang bde ba zung du 'jug pa'i rang bzhin sems can rnams la gdod ma nas gnas pa de'i dbyings su las snang gi rtsa rlung thig le rnams dag par byed dgos pa yin no/

rjes dran skabs su stong gzugs rnam pa thams cad pa dngos su grub ces bya ba la/ rnam pa thams cad pa gdod ma nas yod yod pa yin kyang rnam 'byor pa'i blo ngos la rjes dran ma thob bar du cig car rnam pa thams cad du 'char ma gtub/ /rjes dran thob nas de ltar mngon sum du mthong ba'i don no/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi skabs su stong gzugs dang bde chen zung du 'jug pa'i don ni/ gnas tshul la zung 'jug gdod ma nas yin kyang ting nge 'dzin ma thob bar du rten lus kyi phyogs nas thig le gtso bo/ rtsa rlung 'khor/ brtan pa sems nyid bde ba/ dmigs yul stong gzugs rnams dngos gnas la dbyer med yin kyang*/ rnal 'byor pas dbyer med du mi myong bar bag chags 'khrul pa'i dbang gis tha dad lta bur nyams su myong ba zhig yin pa la/ ting nge 'dzin thob nas ngo skal kyi 'khrul pa de zad pas/ de dag dbyer med gcig yin pa la yin par nyams su myong bas zung 'jug go /de ltar na yan lag drug po la yang yul gnas lugs 'gog bden gyis bsdus pa rnams ni ngo bo gcig pa/ don dam rtag brtan chos nyid yin la/ rnal 'byor pa'i blo ngo'i shes pa yul chos nyid dmigs pa'i rnam pa can lam gyis bsdus pa rnams ni 'dus byas mi rtag pa/ kun rdzob yin par shes par bya'o/ /daun dam pa ni dus kyis ma bsdus pa'i phyir don dam rang ngos nas sor sdud kyi dus kyi stong gzugs dang bde ba zhes pa nas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi stong gzugs dang bde ba zhes pa'i bar du dbye ba med la/ lam gyi yan lag drug po dmigs pa'i yul chos nyid gcig nyid la dmigs pa yin kyang*/ lam yan lag drug po rang la gnas skabs tha dad pa drug 'byung zhing*/ de dang de'i skabs rtogs tshul tha dad pa yang drug byung ba yin no/ /des na yan lag dang po bzh-i+i'i stong gzugs rnam pa thams cad pa ma yin pa dang*/ phyi ma gnyis la yin no zer ba dang*/

yan lag dang po lnga'i bde ba mi 'gyur ba ma yin pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bde ba 'gyur med ces zer ba dang*/ de bzh-in du sor sdud kyi rtags snang mi brtan la bsam gtan gyi brtan zer ba sogs de 'dra'i rigs kyi rnam gzhag thams cad rnal 'byor pa'i blo ngo dang bstan pa yin gyi dngos gnas ma yin pas/ rang lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i grub mtha'i tshig gsal por brjod na/ lam yan lag dang po bzhi la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i sems kyis rnam pa thams cad pa'i stong gzugs de yang rnam pa phyogs re bar mthong*/ lam phyi ma gnyis la gnas pa'i sems kyis rnam pa thams cad pa rang du mthong*/ de bzhin du gnas tshul gyi bde ba 'gyur med de ma myong bar rkyen las byung ba'i bde ba tsam myong ba yin kyang*/ de'i rgyu la bde ba 'gyur med de sbas pa'i tshul gyi yod do/ /zhes dang*/ lam sor sdud kyi rtogs pa kho na la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i sems kyi stong gzugs de skabs der rnal 'byor pa dais mi brtan par mthong yang dngos gnas la stong gzugs de rtag pa yin zhes brjod par bya'o/ de dag ni rnal 'byor yan lag drug gi rim pa drug po ngo sprod pa ste ngo sprod skor brgyad pa'o/ /da ni rnam grangs gzhan dang gzhan gyi sgo nas ngo sprod pa la ting nge 'dzin gyi dbye ba dang*/ rdo rje 'beb pa'i ye shes dang*/ 'phros don phra mo tsam ste gsum las/ dang po ting nge 'dzin gyi dbye ba'i ngo sprod ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las gsungs pa'i ting nge 'dzin brgya nyi shu sogs kyang rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ting nge 'dzin 'di la tshang*/ rnam pa mtha' yas pa gsungs pa rnams kyang zhi ba'i rnam pa la 'dus par gsungs pa ltar/ ting nge 'dzin dang rnam pa dmigs pa thams cad rnam par mi rtog pa khyad par can 'di la tshang ba yin/ sems gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya ba ni dben gsum nyams su myong ba tshun chod na yod la/

kun du snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ khams gsum gyi gzugs brnyan stong gzugs snang ba dang*/ sgron ma 'bar ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ 'od gsal gyi gzi brjid kyis las snang bcil bar byed pa dang*/ gdung ba med pa'i glog gi 'od ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ 'od gsal rtags bcu la mnyam par bzhag pa'i rang mdangs las sems can rnams kyi sems dang spyod pa yang shes/ de'i sems dang 'phrod pa'i chos kyang shes pa'o/ /rin chen snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni ser po 'bar ba dang*/ rin chen sgron ma zhes bya ba ni nag po 'bar ba dang*/ zla ba snang ba zhes bya ba ni dkar po 'bar ba dang*/ spyi gtsug rnam par blta ba ni sor bsam dngos dang*/ 'od zer rab tu 'gyed pa ni glog gi snang ba dang*/ blta bas chog mi shes pa zhes pa ni sangs rgyas kyi gzugs dang*/ phyogs rnam par lta ba zhes bya ba ni nam mkha' sprin med pa lta bu dang*/ nam mkha' rgyas par 'gengs pa zhes bya ba ni thig le chen po dang*/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan zhes bya ba ni/ rtsa ba'i stong gzugs gcig shin tu brtan zhing brtsegs pa la stong gzugs du ma 'phro 'du byed pa'am/ rtsa dbu ma'i nang du stong gzugs langs pa dang*/ dri ma med pa'i sgron ma zhes bya ba ni/ rtags bcu la gzung 'dzin med par shes pa dang*/ 'od mtha' yas pa ni re kha nag po dang*/ 'od byed pa ni 'od skor rgya cher 'phel ba dang*/ 'od dri ma med pa ni 'ja' tshon lta bu'i 'od kyi snang ba rgyas pa dang*/ nyi ma'i sgron ma ni dmar po 'bar ba dang*/ zla ba dri ma med pa ni thig le'i snang ba dang stong gzugs ro gcig pa dang*/ snang ba gsal ba ni rtsa rnams thig les gang ba'i snang ba dang*/ snang ba byed pa ni de las mngon shes 'char ba dang*/ dge ba'i me tog rgyas shing gsal ba ni yul lnga stong gzugs su thim pas bde ba'i snang ba rgyas te tha mal ba'i 'dod yon la chags pa dag pa dang*/

sgra dang brda la 'jug pa ni stong pa'i sgra dang las snang gi sgra 'dres pas sems can thams cad kyi skad dang nges tsh-ig shes pa dang*/ sgra dbyangs dang ldan pa ni gzhom med kyi nā da'i sgra dang*/ sgron ma 'bar ba ni gtum mo'i 'bar snang stong gzugs ro gcig pa dang/ rnam pa'i mchog thams cad dang ldan pa ni rjes dran phan chad kyi stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mo dang*/ nam mkha' dang 'dra ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang glog gi sgron ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni stong gzugs kyi gtum mo glog dang 'dra bas zhu bde 'gyur med kyi dga' bzhi drangs shing*/ de'i mthar rtsa rlung thig le dbyings nam mkha' dang 'dra bar thim pa ste/ ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag phan chad yin la/ de dag la sogs pa'i mdo sde dang rgyud sde tha dad nas gsungs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin grangs med pa thams cad rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'dir yongs su 'dus pa yin no/ /de dag ni ting nge 'dzin gyi dbye ba ngo sprad pa ste/ ngo sprod skor dgu pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje 'bebs pa'i ye shes ngo sprad par bya ste/ dbang gi dus su skal ldan mchog ma gtogs pa gzhan la ni ye shes yud tsam zhig phebs pa las lhag po med cing*/ dbang don rdzogs rim sgom pa'i skabs 'dir ni dbang po rab 'bring tha ma gang yin yang rung*/ lam 'di la brten pa'i nyams myong skyes phyin ye shes brtan por mi phebs pa mi srid do/ /de ltar rtsa rgyud las/ phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /rdo rje 'bebs pas byin gyis brlabs/ zhes gsungs te/ sor bsam la rdo rje 'bebs pa chung ngu*/ srog 'dzin la 'bring po/ rjes dran la chen po/ ting nge 'dzin la mthar thug pa rdo rje 'bebs pa'i ye shes bzhi po rnams 'byung ngo*/ /ji ltar 'bab pa'i tshul ni ye shes dbab pa'i skabs kyi rgyud rtsa 'grel dang*/ rdo rje snying 'grel sogs na gsal te/

lung khungs rnams bris na mangs par 'gyur bas/ don gyi snying po 'di lta bu yin no/ /de yang rnam rtog nub cing*/ sems gsal stong ngam bde stong la g.yo ba med par gnas pa'i ngang nas/ lus 'phar g.yo dang ngag smra rgod sogs dang 'brel bar khro bo'i tshul gyis brdeg pa dang sdigs pa sogs ni/ khro bo rnams kyi sku dang*/ drag sngags dang*/ drag tu rgod pa dang*/ brdegs shig choms shig ces pa'i tshig 'don pa ni khro bo'i gsung dang*/ cung zad nyams srabs pas mthong thos kyi snang ba mi 'gag cing dogs pa dang 'dzem pa sogs rnam par rtog pa rags pa nub la dpa' ba'i gdeng chen po dang ldan na khro bo'i thugs babs pa'o/ /de dag la yang nang tshan du shin tu stobs dang rmugs byed dang*/ khengs byed dang*/ rengs byed dang*/ rdo rje shugs la sogs pa so so'i dbye ba du ma yod do/ /zhi ba'i sku phebs pas ni bro gar la sogs pas 'phar g.yo'i rnam grangs du ma 'byung*/ gsung phebs pas ni saṃskri ta la sogs pa yul dang 'gro ba du ma'i skad dang*/ chos kyi sgra sna tshogs pa 'byung*/ thugs phebs pas ni lus ngag g.yo ba med cing sems bde gsal gyi ngang nas phyi nang thams cad rig pa 'byung*/ ye shes rdo rje phebs pas sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad dam/ ci rigs pa bdag nyid la yod pa snyam byed pa 'byung*/ de bzhin du sangs rgyas spyan ma phebs pas/ lus stobs dang ldan pa gzhan gyis g.yo 'gul mi thub pa dang mā ma kī phebs pas rang lus bsil zhing gzhan yang bsal bar byed pa dang*/ gos dkar mo phebs pas dro zhing rngul ba dang*/ sgrol ma phebs pas shin tu yang zhing rtsal che ba dang*/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma phebs pas mchog la mi snang ba dngos 'grub cing*/ phal pa la rlung gi rgyu ba chad pa dang*/ gzhan gyis btsal na mi rnyed pa la sogs pa 'byung*/ de bzhin du gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa phebs pa'i lkog gyur gyi gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos khams sna tshogs pa shais pa dang*/

stong pa'i gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya sngar med mtha' yas pa cig car snang ba dang*/ rig pa dang bstan bcos sngar ma bslabs pa shes pa'i snang ba 'byung*/ des mtshon nas rnam snang phebs pas lus mdog dbyibs sna tshogs su 'gyur ba dang*/ 'od dpag med phebs pas res 'ga' 'du shes rnam rtog rags/ res 'ga' stong par thim pa 'byung ba dang*/ rin 'byung phebs pas bde sdug gi tshor ba sna tshogs myong ba dang*/ don yod grub pa phebs pas las dang bya ba 'grub mi thub pa skad cig gis 'grub pa dang*/ mi bskyod pa phebs pas rnam shes lnga bde gsal du 'char ba dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum phebs pa ni gong gi ye shes rdo rje dang gcig go /byang chub sems dpa' drug phebs pas kyang rna ba sogs dbang po drug gi gnas rnams la rnam 'gyur sna tshogs 'byung zhing mngon shes drug po ci rigs par 'char ba dang*/ khro bo rnams la yang las dbang bya ba dang bcas pa'i rnam 'gyur mang du 'byung zhing*/ de dag la brten pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi cha shas ci rigs pa 'char ro/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams babs na thams cad kyi thun mong du bde nyams che zhing khro chags spel mar 'byung*/ ma mo rnams so so'i nyams dang mthun pa dang*/ so so'i dam tshig gi rdzas rnams don du gnyer ba sogs 'byung*/ de bzhin du tshes kyi lha rnams la yang ste/ srin po'i khro ba dang*/ me lha'i ji tsam zos kyang yog pa dang*/ tshangs pa'i gti mug dang*/ drag po'i 'dod chags dang*/ khyab 'jug gi zhe sdang dang*/ brgya byin gyi nga rgyal la sogs pa 'char te/ nyon mongs de dang de'i rnam pa can gyi ye shes so/ /de bzhin du sgo skyong rnams babs pas bya ba sna tshogs la 'jug 'dod dang*/ klu rnams babs pas 'dod pa shas che zhing phra ma'i rnam pa dang*/ rab gtum ma rnams babs pas khro gtum shas che ba'i rnam 'gyur dang de bzhin du lha rnams dang gzhal med khang la sogs pa babs pas srid pa gsum po mtha' dag gi rnam 'gyur yang 'byung ngo*/

/'dod phyir 'dod ma rnams kyang 'bab par 'gyur te/ sa dang rlung 'dres pas phra ma byed cing dbye bar 'dod pa 'byung ba la sogs pa/ 'od gsal rnam pa thams cad pa nyid du gdod nas rtag par bzhugs kyang rkyen de dang des mngon du 'gyur te/ chu dang rlung ni rnam bsres pas/ /lus can rnams ni 'dar bar 'gyur/ /des grang reg skyes te gos 'dod pa'am lus 'dar ba dang/ rlung dang stong pa rnam bsres pas/ skad cig gis ni thams cad skrod/ /ces pha rol skrod par 'dod pa dang*/ me dang sa ni rnam bsres pas/ /lus can kun la tsha rim 'byung*/ /zhes gdung ba drag po 'dod pa dang*/ me dang ye shes rnam bsres pas/ /thams cad du ni 'bebs par byed/ /ces ye shes phebs pas 'phar g.yo'i sgo nas lus bskyod par 'dod pa yin/ de bzhin du des gtsang btsog med pas lhag ma za bar yang 'dod do/ /rlung dang me ni rnam bsres pas/ /lus can rnams ni 'gugs pa'o/ /zhes 'gugs par 'dod pa dang*/ me dang stong pa rnam bsres pas/ /skad cig gis ni rim 'debs 'gyur/ /zhes skems par 'dod pa dang*/ rlung dang stong pa rnam bsres pas/ lus can rnams ni gsod par 'gyur/ zhes g.yul sprod par 'dod pa dang*/ sa dang chu ni rnam bsres pas/ / lus can rnams ni rgyas par 'gyur/ zhes rgyas par 'dod pa dang*/ stong pa'i yi ges dug rnams bskyod/ /ces pa ltar/ chu dang nam mkha' 'dres pas tshig rtsub kyi rgyu khro chags kyi dug zhi nas 'jam par smra bar 'dod pa dang*/ sa yi dag pas rings par byed/ /ces rengs par 'dod pa dang*/ sa dang stong pa rnams bsres pas/ lus can rnams ni ltung bar 'gyur/ /zhes sbrul la sogs pa ltung ba ste/ 'ching bar 'dod ma ste de dag la sogs pa 'dod phyir 'dod gzhan rnams phebs pa la yang rigs 'gre ba shes par bya'o/ /mdor na don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bde gsheg snying po'i ngo bor rang nyid la bzhugs pa rnams rnal 'byor pas lam nyams su blangs pas thugs rgyud bskul te rang la byin gyis brlabs shing ye shes phebs pa'i rnam 'gyur yin pas/

byin gyis rlob byed kyi ye shes pa ni gtso bor rang rgyud kyi de rnams yin la/ slob dpon gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs dang*/ gzhan rgyud dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis kyang rkyen byed pa ni yin no/ /de ltar na ye shes phebs pa'i nyams 'di kun la yang nyams myong dang man ngag gi rgyus med pas bltas na smyo ba ltar snang ba dang*/ rgyal ba ltar snang ba dang*/ na tsha sdug bsngal lta bur snang ba mang du 'byung bas rtsa rlung thig le gegs dang*/ gdon gyi gnod pa sogs su 'dzin pa yod cing*/ de dang der bzung na rnam rtog gi skyon gyis gegs su 'gro la/ de dag ye shes su ngo shes pas byung rgyal du bskyangs na rtsa mdud grol zhing*/ rtsa gnas byang chub kyi sems kyis gang nas/ bde stong gi nyams rgya mtsho lta bur 'gro ba la tshegs med do/ /sbyor drug bsgoms nas nyams kyi ye shes rtag tu phebs par gyur na/ gegs sngar yod thams cad las grol zhing*/ gegs gsar pa 'byung ba med la/ yon tan zla ba yar ngo ltar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar na sbyor drug pa'i nyams 'ur ba dang*/ nyams phebs pa zhes grags pa 'di yang rnam pa thams cad pa'i nang tshan yin pas/ stong gzugs dang gnad gcig la/ nyams phebs tshabs che na/ stong gzugs kyang gsal la mang*/ stong gzugs mang po 'char/ rtsa bzang po la nyams rtag tu phebs 'ong bas/ 'phral blo ngor yang 'gro ldog gcig tu yod do/ /de dag ni rdo rje 'bebs pa'i nyams ngo sprod pa ste/ ngo sprod skor bcu pa'o/ /da ni 'phros don phra mo 'ga' zhig bshad par bya ste/ gzhan yang stong pa'i gzugs thams cad la rdo rje'i gzugs/ stong pa'i sgra thams cad la rdo rje'i sgra zhes sogs tha snyad sbyar nas/ stong gzugs dang las snang thams cad la sbyor te/ rdo rje'i don stong pa yin pas snang stong dbyer med yin la/ 'on kyang bden pa gnyis la stong tshul gnyis dang snang tshul gnyis gong ngo sprod drug pa'i skabs su bstan pa ltar ro/

/de bzhin du gnas skabs bzh-i'i snang ba la rags pa'i 'od dam snang ba'i 'od gsal zer/ bde ba chen po la rang bzhin gsal/ stong gzugs la de kho na nyid kyi 'od gsal zhes 'dogs pa'i skabs kyang yod/ yang snang ba'i steng du 'od gsal 'dzin pa'i skabs su 'di skad ces bya ste/ lam bsgoms pas ma dag pa'i snang ba dbyings su dag nas/ gzhi'i gnas lugs mngon du gyur pa la 'bras bur 'jog pa'i gnad kyis/ stong gzugs la rtsol bas mnyam par 'jog pa'i lam gyis las snang ma dag pa'i snang ba de 'od gsal stong gzugs la bsdus pas las snang 'gags te stong gzugs kho na 'char pa yin no/ /zhes dang*/ yang stong gzugs mthong ba'i dus phyi rol rgyang chad ltar snang ba la/ mig btsum pa'am/ lag pas bkab pa sogs byas nas phyi rol kyi gzugs su grub na de dag gis sgrib dgos pa las/ de la thogs sgrib med pas sems kyi snang ba'o/ /zhes bya ba dang*/ bsam gtan gyi dga' bde'i yan lag phyogs mthun rgyud la skyes pa la stong gzugs dang bde chen zung 'jug tu dpe'i ngo sprod pa'ang yod de/ rtags snang mi gsal na bde ba shas chung*/ rtags snang gsal na dga' bde shas che ste/ de dga' bde dang rtags snang ngo bo gcig pa'i rtags yin/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid dang mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba yang 'di lta bu ste/ rang bzhin dbyer med zung 'jug gdod ma'i gshis lugs so/ /zhes sogs brda thabs sna tshogs la brten nas ngo sprod pa gong ma rnams kyi phyag len no/ /de dag la thun dang grangs nges pa med cing*/ ngo sprod skor gyi rim pa'ang med mod/ sde tshan gcig tu byas pas na le'u'i rim pa bcu gcig par byas na legs so/ /de ltar na rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong nyid phyag rgya chen mo dang*/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po zung du 'jug pa de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ 'khor lo sdom pa dang*/

dgyes pa rdo rje dang*/ gsang ba 'dus pa dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo dang*/ e waṃ zung 'jug dang*/ rnam bcu dbang ldan dang*/ nyi zla kha sbyor dang*/ chos 'byung la gnas pa'i thig le dang*/ yang dag par mi bslu ba dang*/ spros bral dang*/ bde bar gshegs pa dang*/ cha med kun 'gro dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa' ris med pa dang*/ khyab bdag dang dam pa'i bdag dang*/ kun khyab bde ba chen po'o/ /zhes pa zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi ngo sprod nang ma thun mong ma yin pa zab cing rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos mtha' dag gi nges gsang 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas shin tu gsal bar brjod pa ste/ nags rgyal gyi dben gnas dpal jo nang du'o/ /ngo spraud kyi yi ge 'di kun mkhyen dus gsum sangs rgyas jo nang pa chen po dol po pa shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi dgongs bzhed thun mong ma yin pa ches zab cing gsang ba rnams yin pas/ gzhung lugs mi shes pa rnams la cung zad go dka' bar 'gyur mod/ zab don go dka' ba de kun gyi lugs yin/ grub mtha' phal pas sems khengs pa phal cher gyi blor shong dka' bas/ brgyud pa 'di kho na las byon pa'i chos 'd-i'i myong khrid thob pa rnams ma gtogs gzhan la bka' rgyas btab bo// //dge legs 'phel// //zhus dag shubhaṃ//
